name: Automotive Fuel Cell Industry
description: Starting from zero-emission commercial vehicle demand, trace upstream into fuel-cell stacks, MEAs, catalysts, GDL, hydrogen storage, and air compressor bottlenecks.
terminalDemand: Zero-emission heavy-duty trucks, buses, logistics vehicles, and forklifts.
researchThesis: Use commercial vehicle fuel-cell demand as the anchor, then trace upstream to high-barrier nodes such as stacks, MEAs, catalysts, GDL, onboard hydrogen storage, and BOP air compressors.

languagePolicy.sourcePreference: Prioritize English official sources, investor relations materials, filings, government sources, and standards bodies. Non-English sources may be submitted only when they add primary evidence and should be summarized in English.

companies.name: Johnson Matthey
companies.businessRole: Core supplier in fuel-cell catalysts, CCM, and MEA-related activities

signals.importantSupplier: Yes. It sits in the catalyst and MEA value chain.
signals.bottleneckPosition: High. Catalysts and MEAs have long validation cycles.
signals.playerConcentration: High. The global pool of qualified core players is limited.
signals.recentCatalyst: Track orders, capacity plans, and customer validation for fuel-cell materials.

recentUpdates: Fuel-cell materials are tied to PEM supply chain adoption; customer validation and capacity plans need ongoing monitoring.
Platinum-group metal prices and catalyst thrifting technology can affect long-term margins.

companies.name: Umicore
companies.businessRole: Fuel-cell catalyst and precious-metals recycling company

signals.bottleneckPosition: Medium-high, depending on customer qualification and share.
signals.recentCatalyst: Track catalyst orders, precious-metals recycling, and materials guidance.

recentUpdates: Precious-metals materials and recycling capability are underlying advantages for fuel-cell catalyst activity.

companies.name: FORVIA

signals.importantSupplier: Yes. It serves hydrogen storage systems for fuel-cell vehicles.
signals.bottleneckPosition: Medium-high. Tank safety, weight, and cost requirements are demanding.
signals.recentCatalyst: Track commercial vehicle customers, capacity ramp, and hydrogen business orders.

recentUpdates: Hydrogen storage systems should scale with fuel-cell truck and bus demand.

signals.recentCatalyst: Track fuel-cell compressor customer partnerships and commercial vehicle programs.

recentUpdates: Fuel-cell compressors are an often underappreciated BOP bottleneck.

name: AI Optical Module Industry
description: Trace AI data-center demand into high-speed switching, optical modules, DSPs, silicon photonics, lasers, external light sources, packaging, and module manufacturing.
terminalDemand: High-speed data-center interconnect demand driven by AI training and inference clusters.
researchThesis: Start from AI cluster scale-out demand, then trace upstream to scarce optical interconnect nodes: high-speed switches, pluggable optical modules, PAM4 DSPs, silicon photonics, EML and laser devices, CPO external light sources, packaging, and high-yield module manufacturing.

languagePolicy.sourcePreference: Prioritize English official sources, investor relations materials, product pages, filings, standards bodies, and company technical announcements.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.businessRole: AI networking system provider and major demand shaper for CPO and silicon-photonics architectures

signals.importantSupplier: Yes. NVIDIA is a demand shaper and system architecture sponsor for AI optical interconnect roadmaps.
signals.bottleneckPosition: Medium. NVIDIA is strategic, but the tighter upstream bottlenecks sit in switch silicon, optical engines, lasers, packaging, and module manufacturing.
signals.playerConcentration: High at the AI system level.
signals.recentCatalyst: Track Spectrum-X Photonics, CPO networking switches, AI factory scale-out, and networking roadmap disclosures.

recentUpdates: NVIDIA is mapped as a system-level AI networking demand shaper using English official investor materials.
Refresh with official networking, Spectrum-X, and CPO product announcements.

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.businessRole: Switch ASIC, CPO platform, DSP, optical engine, and pluggable laser source supplier

signals.importantSupplier: Yes. Broadcom links several scarce nodes: switch ASIC, CPO, DSP, optical engine integration, and laser-source architecture.
signals.bottleneckPosition: High. CPO qualification, platform integration, and switching silicon create a hard-to-replace position.
signals.playerConcentration: High in merchant switching and CPO platform capability.
signals.recentCatalyst: Track CPO platform adoption, Bailly-class switching, pluggable laser source demand, and hyperscaler qualification.

recentUpdates: Broadcom is mapped as a hidden bottleneck candidate because it spans switch ASICs, CPO, DSP, optical engines, and laser-source architecture.
Verify customer adoption, CPO ramps, and laser source architecture disclosures through official product and investor materials.

signals.recentCatalyst: Track AI infrastructure DSP product updates, 800G/1.6T transitions, and linear-drive optics commentary.
